title: platform-objects: the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES help text for sys_user.role still points at the retired Set Platform Role action, and no i18n gate sees it (no source-hash entry)
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, the `objects.sys_user.fields.role.help` leaves in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.objects.generated.ts`. Finding class **(a)**. #15188 residue: PR #17102 fixed the `en` text only.

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01TEhopqrWQYBycZzyJHpAZr`) from the out-of-scope findings of its #19875 dev (report on #19875). The seat's isolated contract reviewer confirmed it on PR #19892 (record 5798003286, flag ③-1: 「REAL … FILE SEPARATELY」). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

`zh-CN` reads 「平台级角色（admin、user 等）。通过“设置平台角色”操作设置。」, and `ja-JP` and `es-ES` say the same: set it through the "Set Platform Role" action. That action was retired in #9968. The `en` value was rewritten by PR #17102 and again by PR #19892 (#19875), which now names `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and the `single`-posture grant.

The leaf has no entry in any locale's `source-hashes.generated.ts` / `source-hashes.ts` (0 hits in all six files). So `check:i18n` (merge mode keeps translated values) and `check:i18n-stale-fill` (a leaf without a hash is legacy-trusted) cannot report it.

## Reach

A Setup administrator using one of those three locales sees field help telling them to press a button that does not exist, on every tenancy posture.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

Rewrite the three hand-written values as translations of the current `en` text (AGENTS.md allows editing a translated value), and give the leaf a source-hash entry so the next `en` change is reported. Land after PR #19892.

## Filing-gate answers

- **Class**: ① (defect, named landing site); finding class (a), read by the dev and confirmed by the seat's reviewer.
- **Acting reader**: the seat that owns `packages/platform-objects` after triage routes it (`domain:engine`).
- **Dedupe**, MCP issue search in this repo, `closed` included: `Set Platform Role translation sys_user role help zh-CN ja-JP es-ES stale legacy-trusted translation` → 3 hits: #19875 (the `en` text this card follows), #16165 and #8718 (closed, other stale translated leaves of the same class on different fields). None is this defect.
